kjv: [as] musical instruments, and that of all sorts
note: Hebrew shiddah weshiddot (hapax) is most likely "a woman and women", i.e. a harem, following "the delights of the sons of man"; the KJV's "musical instruments" is a guess from the Targum. Context: concubines (medium confidence). The list ends 'the delights of the sons of man', after singers; a harem fits the catalogue of a king's pleasures.
MT chuts mimmenni "apart from me"; the LXX, Syriac and some Hebrew manuscripts read mimmennu "apart from him" (God), matching v. 24. I follow the latter.
